title_en: You Wear a Brand-New Skin Every Month #Shorts
desc_en:
Your skin looks the same every day, but it sheds roughly 30,000 to 40,000 dead cells every minute. New cells rise from below and reach the surface in about a month, so over 80 years you wear close to 1,000 new skins.

Sources: KidsHealth (Nemours); Skin Cancer Foundation (about a month, slower with age). The 1,000 figure is calculated: 80 years divided by about one month.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
